prompt: User: Plan a 3-day trip to Rome for 2 friends who like nature. Budget: mid-range. Travelling 3/9 15:00 to 5/9 21:30, starting and ending at Fiumicino Airport. Staying at Hotel 55 Fifty-Five, Via Nazionale. Each day should run roughly 09:00 to 22:00. Must-see: Colosseum, Pantheon, Trevi Fountain, Trastevere, St Peter's Basilica. Avoid: indoor museums. Also: we walk a lot, we want a shopping stop at noon on one day.
